note: biz = temporal endpoint "until" (Zeit); 87.5% corpus majority; OT narrative context: "biz zu/an/in [Zeit/Ereignis]" dominant; spatial endpoint sense (28164) is minority (~12%) — accepted residual

werden = auxiliary/functional verb (Funktionswörter); 74% corpus majority; WZB contexts: predominantly future aux (wirt + inf) and passive aux (wart/wirt + pp); become+adjective instances (sense_12207: wirt vnrein, wart czornig) and existence (wart ein hunger) are minority ~15% — accepted residual; becoming/Werden sense (12209) rare

gehen = movement/motion (Bewegung); 71.2% corpus majority; OT context: all sampled instances are literal motion "gehen/geen/gieng/giengen" = to go/walk; peripheral senses (riding 2853, seafaring 2852, battle 2850, expanse 20475) essentially absent in pentateuch narrative; decision sense (2848) marginal
